date_note: Date is SMBC's announcement of 20 November; the intrusion into PLAID's KARTE was reported to SMBC on 13 November.
title: SMBC says up to about 14 million customer records leaked via PLAID KARTE breach
summary: Cybersecurity.com reports that SMBC announced on 20 November a leak of customer information, up to about 14 million records, after unauthorized access to KARTE at its contractor PLAID. The article says the data includes date of birth and category values; name, address, phone, email, account number and internet-banking login are not included. No impact on assets or transactions is confirmed so far.
plain: Sumitomo Mitsui Bank says up to about 14 million customer records leaked through its contractor PLAID's KARTE service. Names, account numbers and logins are reported not included.
exec: Up to about 14 million bank customer records exposed through a vendor's marketing tool.
action: SMBC customers: watch for phishing that uses your date of birth and follow SMBC's own notices.

validation.note: Only Cybersecurity.com's report of SMBC's 20 Nov notice was read; SMBC's PDF could not be decoded.

review.note: Compared up to about 14M figure, data types and exclusions, 20 Nov announcement, 13 Nov notice and no-asset-impact statement against Cybersecurity.com report (single source, so single_source kept; SMBC PDF not read)
